visualDirection.name: Open Field
visualDirection.principle: Warm institutional clarity with the Oreo mascot used as a human signal, not as decoration on every surface.

typography.sans: Use the system sans stack for navigation, body text, data and primary headlines.
typography.serif: Use the display serif for short editorial clauses and emphasis, never for dense interface copy.
typography.mono: Use the monospace stack for labels, dates, versions, provenance and compact technical metadata.

geometry: Build layouts from generous editorial grids, large rounded fields and fine structural rules.
Use circles, arcs and asymmetric fields to show relationships or movement, not as empty decoration.
Use a restrained dot texture only where it does not compete with text or evidence.
visualDirection.iconography: Use a project's verified icon when one exists and an original geometric fallback when it does not. Do not borrow another organization's signature symbols.

mascotUsage.rule: Oreo is a recognizable human signal. Keep the approved proportions and marks, and do not let the mascot replace evidence, diagrams or project identity.

motion: Prefer short opacity and transform transitions that explain hierarchy or state.
Keep touch scrolling native; enhanced inertia is optional on capable pointer devices.
Disable non-essential animation when reduced motion is requested.
accessibility: Maintain WCAG AA contrast for text and controls.
Do not communicate status through colour alone.
Keep focus states visible and all actions keyboard reachable.
Provide meaningful alternative text for informative artwork and empty alternative text for decoration.

excludedFromPublicMigration: .env and all encrypted or unencrypted credentials
local caches, virtual environments, and generated temporary files
migrationPrinciples: Preserve source history before archiving the standalone repository.
Keep editable masters, optimized web derivatives, prompts, and generated outputs in separate directories.
Do not copy exact duplicates or secrets into the portal.
Record provenance and artifact-specific licensing for every migrated group.

note: The portal now owns the public canonical copies. Generation pipelines, prompts, sticker archives, and their provenance remain staged for a separate reviewed migration before the standalone branding repository can be archived.
